=== SESSION HANDOFF — epic 061c, integration state and the ONE thing blocking the push ===

GIT STATE. Everything below is COMMITTED on feat/llm-provider-seam in
/Users/joeoakhart/rebar-wt-provider-seam but NOT YET PUSHED:

    ad5ced165  7f86: ADR 0056 -- decompose PydanticAIRunner.run()
    a3c4fd472  cc33: consume per-class fallback chains        (cherry-picked from its worktree)
    04664d1fd  cb6f: add REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE with deep layering  (cherry-picked)
    ef060e80d  172e: verifier paths resolve the standard class
    97791145f  a574  <- last PUSHED commit, Gerrit change 1104, +1/+1

All four commit trailers verified with `rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev <sha>`.
The two subagent worktrees (rebar-wt-cc33, rebar-wt-cb6f) each hold their own commit on their own
branch; those are now REDUNDANT with the cherry-picks and can be removed once the stack pushes.

THE ONE BLOCKER. The full suite on the integrated stack is 8221 passed / 1 FAILED:

    tests/unit/test_structured_run_seam.py::test_runner_regains_real_headroom_under_the_cap
    AssertionError: runner.py is 782 LOC; the split must bring it under 700

That is task 3a98's headroom guard ("runner.py must stop sitting ON the 800 gate, not merely pass
it"). cc33's +97 lines regrew the file past it. DO NOT PUSH until this is green, and DO NOT relax
the guard -- that is the "raise the cap" anti-pattern ADR 0056 rejects by name, and it would discard
the one mechanism that caught the regression.

THE FIX is story 7f86, whose children are already planned and reviewed:

    e6bd  Extract interpret_failure() from run()'s except spine   PASS, SIGNED, claimable NOW
    8229  Extract build_model_settings() + build_usage_limits()   blocked by e6bd
    a49e  Guard the provider session with a context manager       review in flight at handoff

REQUIRED ARITHMETIC -- one extraction is NOT enough:
    782  now
    -75  e6bd (except spine)      -> 707   STILL OVER
    -80  8229 (settings block)    -> ~627  under
a49e is roughly LOC-neutral (swaps construct+finally for a `with`).

A CIRCULAR CONSTRAINT I WROTE AND HAVE NOW CORRECTED. 7f86 originally said "LAND NOTHING HERE UNTIL
cc33 MERGES" -- but cc33 cannot merge while it breaks 7f86's own guard. The real requirement was
"do not AUTHOR against a pre-cc33 base"; cc33 is now IN the stack, so that is satisfied and the
children extract the POST-cc33 code in the same stack. 7f86's description is fixed; do not
reintroduce the wait.

a49e IS INDEPENDENTLY VALUABLE and fixes a VERIFIED latent defect, not just LOC: ProviderSession is
constructed at runner.py:301 but the try guarding it starts at 474 (finally-close at 582), so lines
301-473 leak an opened httpx.AsyncClient when they raise -- and _check_tool_capability raises there
BY DESIGN. ProviderSession.__enter__/__exit__ exist at providers.py:295-299 and are never used,
while providers.py:21 documents a `with ProviderSession(...)` caller that does not exist. Land a49e
even if the rest is descoped.

EPIC STATE
  closed:      S1 7468, S2 f184, S3 2932, S4 dc0d, S7 9249, f844, 1484, a574, + bugs 1903/281f/3a98
  in_progress: eb58 (parent), 172e, cb6f, cc33 (all three IMPLEMENTED, awaiting push+CI+close),
               343b (gap 5 -- provider_provenance still unwired into finalize_verdict)
  open:        7761 (LAST unstarted class task), d23e (blocked by 172e+7761),
               S6 0d76, S8 eb6e, S9 8625 (all blocked by eb58), 7f86 + its three children

7761 IS THE LAST UNSTARTED CLASS TASK. Its plan is PASS/signed. It consumes the SAME
model_classes.resolve_model_string that 172e added, for the Pass-1 ladder rungs, and it must also
fix the second split-brain: models_at_or_above("bedrock:...") returns BARE Anthropic ids, so a
Bedrock run escalating on a context-limit error silently jumps to DIRECT ANTHROPIC. Verified by
direct probe. It targets sizing.py + the two batch runners, NOT runner.py, so it should fit the cap.

MEASURED FACTS, do not re-derive:
- Bedrock prompt caching WORKS on sonnet AND opus (cache_read 542,723 over a 19-call gate run). Bug
  7a79's silent no-op is a DIRECT-ANTHROPIC-path problem; Bedrock fixes it.
- Bedrock sonnet accepts temperature=0.0; Bedrock opus rejects every value except default 1.0. So
  greedy Pass-2 survives on sonnet and is silently INOPERATIVE on opus -> keep the verifier on sonnet.
- A real gate run on bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 COMPLETED: 19 calls, substantive BLOCK
  verdict, zero provider errors.
- cc33 is a HARD PREREQUISITE for eb6e: no single-scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL reproduces today's
  41-opus/1-sonnet split. Pointing at Bedrock sonnet regresses Pass-1; pointing at opus loses the
  verifier downgrade AND greedy decoding.
- The operator has APPROVED the Bedrock cutover; it lands after cc33.

OPERATOR ACTION STILL OUTSTANDING: rotate ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. A subagent ran `env | grep -i anthropic`
and printed it into its transcript. That key's presence is also what would let the provider-crossing
escalation above succeed silently instead of failing loudly.

PROCESS LESSONS THAT COST REAL TIME HERE:
- Backticks in a double-quoted zsh argument are command-substituted and SILENTLY STRIP content from
  ticket bodies. Bit me three times. Write ticket bodies to a file and pass "$(cat file)", or use
  subprocess with list args -- then PROBE the stored text. rc=0 proves nothing.
- `cmd | tail -N` masks the exit code (tail's status wins). It hid a lint failure and once pushed a
  stack after a FAILED commit. Capture exit codes directly.
- A material PLAN edit invalidates the prior PASS in substance; code/test edits do NOT. Check with
  `review-plan <id> --status --ref HEAD` (free, no LLM) before assuming staleness either way.
- Three staleness modes, same remedy, different triggers: stale-head (a landed commit moves HEAD),
  stale-pin-drift (editing a CHILD invalidates the PARENT), stale-material (editing the ticket's
  own plan).
- Gerrit REMOVES votes on a new patchset ("The following approvals got outdated and were removed").
  A +1/+1 you read earlier may belong to a superseded patchset -- re-check after every push.
- ADR numbers collide across concurrent sessions on the shared RebarBotNava identity. ADR 0055 was
  taken by the Jira-family change while I was writing mine; renumbered to 0056.
